fields.title: Library Student Assistant
fields.description: Assist librarians with cataloging, book shelving, student entry check-in, and managing quiet study room bookings.

fields.title: Student IT Helpdesk & Lab Attendant
fields.description: Provide basic hardware and software troubleshooting for computer lab workstations and assist instructors with lab setups.

fields.title: PSU Open House Campus Ambassador
fields.description: Act as campus guides for visiting high school students, manage registration booths, and distribute orientation goodie bags.

fields.title: Sports Complex & Gym Attendant
fields.description: Check student IDs at entrance, sanitize equipment, oversee badminton court reservations, and monitor fitness room safety.

fields.title: International Conference Registration Staff
fields.description: Welcome foreign dignitaries and delegates, assist with English/Chinese conference packet distribution, and usher attendees.

fields.title: Eco-Campus Greenery & Waste Audit Assistant
fields.description: Collect campus recycling metrics, inspect solar monitoring stations, and record data on student sustainability initiatives.

fields.title: Language Experience Workshop Support
fields.description: Assist language instructors in running conversational games and cultural booths for freshman students.

fields.title: Audio-Visual Sound & Stage Technician
fields.description: Set up microphone lines, test live monitors, arrange cabling, and operate stage lights during campus ceremonial events.

fields.title: Campus Coffee Corner Barista & Cashier
fields.description: Prepare espresso beverages, operate POS register, sanitize cafe counter tables, and manage beverage stock inventory.

fields.title: Student Affairs Graphic Design & Poster Creator
fields.description: Design promotional event posters, social media banners, and infographics for upcoming campus extracurricular activities.

fields.title: PSU Swimming Pool Lifeguard & Safety Monitor
fields.description: Supervise lap swimming sessions, verify water quality parameters, test life rings, and enforce pool safety regulations.

fields.title: Registrar Office Document Scanning Clerk
fields.description: Scan and index historical student graduation records, digitize paper transcripts, and perform optical character recognition checks.

fields.title: Botanical Greenhouse Flora Research Assistant
fields.description: Monitor soil moisture sensors, water native mangrove flora specimens, and catalog weekly biological plant growth measurements.

fields.title: Student Dormitory Night Study Hall Proctor
fields.description: Maintain quiet study atmosphere, inspect air-conditioning timers, and verify resident sign-ins during final exam week.

fields.title: International Campus Tour Guide for ASEAN Delegates
fields.description: Escort visiting ASEAN university delegates, present campus landmark histories in English, and coordinate protocol lunch seating.

fields.title: University Bookstore Textbook Stock Clerk
fields.description: Unbox incoming semester textbooks, affix barcode labels, organize academic stationery aisles, and assist customer inquiries.

fields.title: Andamanda Phuket Songkran Festival Crew
fields.description: Provide guest assistance, manage locker rentals, hand out wristbands, and coordinate festival staging area logistics.

fields.title: Central Phuket International Food Fair Staff
fields.description: Assist international culinary chefs, manage sampling stations, guide tourists, and oversee culinary sanitation compliance.

fields.title: Phuket Marathon Route & Hydration Marshal
fields.description: Station at water points along the marathon course, pass electrolytes to runners, report medical emergencies, and cheer athletes.

fields.title: Old Phuket Town Cultural Street Fair Coordinator
fields.description: Manage pedestrian flow along Thalang Road, provide directions in Thai/English/Chinese, and assist traditional craft stalls.

fields.title: Municipal Election Unit Volunteer
fields.description: Direct eligible voters to correct polling stations, verify identification documents, and ensure ballot secrecy guidelines are met.

fields.title: EDC Electronic Music Festival Event Crew
fields.description: VIP entrance accreditation, backstage wristband scanning, credential checks, and guest hospitality assistance.

fields.title: Laguna Phuket Golf Championship Scorekeeper
fields.description: Accompany professional golf flights, input real-time hole strokes onto tablet scoring system, and post leaderboard updates.

fields.title: Phuket International Boat Show Marina Expo Usher
fields.description: Greet high-net-worth yacht visitors, manage pier pontoon access passes, and assist VIP lounge champagne service.

fields.title: Patong Beach Marine Conservation Volunteer
fields.description: Lead beach microplastic screening with community volunteers, document coral debris, and distribute educational leaflets.

fields.title: Kata Rocks Luxury Culinary Showcase Assistant
fields.description: Support Michelin-star guest chef prep stations, polish wine glasses, distribute canapé trays, and verify guest wristbands.

fields.title: Bang Tao Night Market Parking & Traffic Marshal
fields.description: Direct tourist motorbikes and taxis into parking bays, manage crosswalk pedestrian safety, and assist traffic police.

fields.title: Phuket International Airport Tourist Hospitality Greeter
fields.description: Assist international arrivals with customs queue direction, answer transit bus queries, and distribute Phuket safety guides.

fields.title: Old Town Heritage Walk English & Chinese Interpreter
fields.description: Lead 45-minute walking history tours through Soi Rommanee, explaining Sino-Portuguese architecture to foreign tourists.
fields.location_type: Soi Rommanee & Krabi Road, Old Town

fields.title: Phuket Aquarium Marine Habitat Volunteer
fields.organization_name: Department of Marine and Coastal Resources
fields.description: Assist marine biologists with food preparation for sea turtles, clean filtration screens, and guide school field trip groups.
